llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent, but remember it will cause real outbound calls that incur billing. Before installing: 1) Verify the npm/pypi packages and publisher (search @thisispamela on npm and thisispamela on PyPI) to ensure they are genuine and not typosquatting; 2) Use a restricted/test API key and enable billing alerts—keys start with pk_live_ so avoid putting a full production key in public places; 3) Review the provider's privacy/data-retention policy because call audio/transcripts are sent to an external service and may be stored or sent to your webhooks; 4) If you plan to accept webhooks, validate signatures (X-Pamela-Signature) and secure your endpoints; 5) Monitor usage/costs after enabling. If you need higher assurance, ask the skill author for the canonical package links, publisher identity, and a privacy/data-retention statement.
